- Retention metadata (how long logs are retained and in what storage).
- A redactable SOC 2 report (or confirmation of availability).

I attached a short scope worksheet that lists our initial fields. Do you have availability tomorrow or Thursday afternoon PT for a 30-min sync?

Thanks,
Leah Park

Veloria Health

Hannah — quick status:
- Logs: request/auth/admin logs are in s3://redwood-prod-logs/{year}/{month}/ and we keep hot indexes in our internal clickhouse cluster for 13 months. CSV export is straightforward via the export job; it will include timestamp, userid, client_id, action, resource, ip, user_agent.
- Export cadence and size: a 12-month export will be ~2.4GB compressed; I can run a one-off job and deliver a zipped CSV. Time estimate: 3–4 hours to prepare and validate, plus 30 min for transfer to the customer S3 endpoint or secure share.
- Redaction: IPs can be included as full values or hashed — let me know which Veloria prefers.

I’ll also attach an export playbook (export_playbook.sh) with the exact job command and checks for checksum/manifest. I’ll hand off the file after the call if Veloria wants us to push to their S3.

— Aditya
Platform Infrastructure

Attachment: export_playbook.sh (script, 6KB)
